_readme: Ink (57073) seed pools. Run: SEED_POOLS=config/ink.json ./scripts/seed.sh ink [--broadcast]. WETH kind = the chain's wrapped-native (weth9 0x4200..0006, from contracts/deployments/ink.json); the seeder auto-wraps native ETH if short. tHOOK/tUSDC are fresh MINT test tokens. priceAperB values are DEMO ratios (tUSDC is a test token, not a real quote). Real ETH, very cheap L2 — amounts are DEMO-scale; size to the funded deployer balance before --broadcast.
